name: Jellyfin Color Tags
overview: Add colors and names, then drag to reorder. An item can have several colors. The dot appears above the more button on posters and next to the favorite button in the player. A color can also cap the streaming bitrate or always transcode. The color name is saved on the item. English by default; Simplified Chinese for any zh display language, including zh-CN, zh-TW, and zh-HK.
description: Mark items with one or more colored dots on posters and in the web player.

versions.changelog: An item can have several colors. The picker stays open, with colors already on the item on the left and the rest on the right. Colors are shared by every user. Each color name is written to the item's tags. White is not. If several colors are on, any Force transcode applies, and the lowest bitrate cap is used.

Keeps the player color dot, and stops poster dots from covering Playback Info. On the video page those poster buttons are removed. The Playback Info panel sits above any that remain, so its close button receives the click.
